item.frontline.enlistment_papers.desc: Right-click a villager to enlist them in your army.
item.frontline.command_baton.desc1: Right-click: nearby troops fall in and follow you.
item.frontline.command_baton.desc2: Sneak + right-click: nearby troops hold position.
item.frontline.command_baton.desc3: Right-click a block: troops rally to that spot.
hud.frontline.hint: Right mouse: aim  ·  R: reload  ·  V: shoulder camera
msg.frontline.need_nation: Plant a Command Flag and found a nation first.
msg.frontline.army_full: Your army is at its limit of %s soldiers.
msg.frontline.serves: %s serves %s and takes no orders from you.
msg.frontline.dismissed: %s has been discharged and returns to civilian life.
msg.frontline.no_troops: No soldiers of yours within earshot.
msg.frontline.outpost: New outpost of %s raised. It claims %s blocks around the flag.
msg.frontline.already_member: You already belong to a nation.
msg.frontline.no_flag: That flag is gone or already claimed. Place a Command Flag and try again.
msg.frontline.founded: %s founded the nation of %s and raised the %s!
msg.frontline.founded_tip: Your flag claims %s blocks around it. Enlist villagers with Enlistment Papers, arm them with a gun, and give orders with a Command Baton. /nation for more.
msg.frontline.no_nations: No nations have been founded yet.
msg.frontline.invited: %s invites you to join %s. Type /nation join %s
msg.frontline.not_invited: You have not been invited to %s.
msg.frontline.leader_leave: The leader cannot leave. Use /nation disband.
msg.frontline.leader_only: Only the nation's leader can do that.
msg.frontline.bad_color: Use one of %s or a hex colour like #8A1C1C.
msg.frontline.disbanded: The nation of %s has been disbanded.
vehicle.frontline.tank.desc: Heavy armour. Main gun fires explosive shells, coaxial MG on right mouse.
vehicle.frontline.plane.desc: Twin wing guns and bombs. Needs a runway to take off.
vehicle.frontline.heli.desc: Chin gun and rocket pods. Two seats.
vehicle.frontline.jeep.desc: Fast, three seats, ring-mounted machine gun.
vehicle.frontline.controls: Right-click a block to place. Right-click the vehicle to board, sneak to leave, sneak + empty hand to pack up.
hud.frontline.vehicle.tank: W/S drive · A/D turn · mouse aims the turret · LMB cannon · RMB coax MG
hud.frontline.vehicle.jeep: W/S drive · A/D steer · LMB mounted MG
hud.frontline.vehicle.plane: W throttle up · S throttle down · steer with the mouse once airborne · LMB guns · RMB bombs
hud.frontline.vehicle.heli: Space climb · look down to descend · W/S/A/D move · mouse turns · LMB chin gun · RMB rockets
msg.frontline.no_room: Not enough room to unload the vehicle here.
screen.frontline.wheel_store: Click the centre to stash the gun you are holding
screen.frontline.wheel_store_here: Click to store your gun in this slot
screen.frontline.wheel_hint: Point at a gun and release G to draw it
screen.frontline.wheel_tip: Right-click a slot to drop its gun into your inventory · 1-8 selects
